description: This file defines a runtime for handling Telegram message buffers, including debouncing, media processing, and message synthesis for the Telegram bot integration within the openclaw framework.

methods.name: createTelegramInboundBufferRuntime
methods.description: Initializes and returns a runtime environment for handling Telegram message buffers, including debouncing, media processing, and message synthesis.

methods.name: buildSyntheticContext
methods.description: Creates a synthetic Telegram context from a source context and message.

methods.name: buildSyntheticTextMessage
methods.description: Constructs a synthetic message object with specified text and optional date/from, based on a base message.

methods.name: resolveReplyMediaForMessage
methods.description: Resolves media attached to a reply message, fetching media files if present.

methods.name: processMediaGroup
methods.description: Processes a group of media messages, resolving media and invoking the message processing callback.

methods.name: flushTextFragments
methods.description: Combines and processes buffered text fragments into a single message.

methods.name: queueTextFragmentFlush
methods.description: Queues a flush operation for text fragments.

methods.name: runTextFragmentFlush
methods.description: Executes the flush of text fragments and removes the entry from buffer.

methods.name: scheduleTextFragmentFlush
methods.description: Schedules a delayed flush of text fragments based on configured max gap.
